description: Use this when the user asks about one Polymarket market or event: its price, what exactly decides how it resolves, whether an outcome has been proposed or disputed, when it ends, its fees, or how it has moved. Returns prices, bid/ask and spread, change over 1h/24h/7d/30d with a 30-day range, volume and liquidity, taker fees, the resolution rules verbatim with their named source, and the live resolution status (not proposed / proposed and in its challenge window / disputed / resolved). For a multi-outcome event it lists every outcome and whether the prices add up to 100¢; add outcome to drill into one. Accepts a polymarket.com link or a slug from pm_search.

market.description: A polymarket.com link, or a market or event slug from pm_search.

outcome.description: For a multi-outcome event: the outcome label to show in detail ("25 bps decrease").

name: pm_market
title: Market brief
